status_report.title: Status report
status_report.description: A dated status report on a body of work: the figures the product computed, the health rating and the summary, and per value whether it was computed or written by a person (dashboards-and-who-may-see-them REQ-DWMS-004).

subject.title: Body of work
subject.description: The register and schema of its items, its title and deadline, and how status and due date are read.

register.title: Register
register.description: The register that holds the items of this body of work.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema of the items of this body of work.

title.title: Title
title.description: The name of the body of work.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: The date the body of work is due, if it has one.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: The filters that select the items of this body of work.

statusProperty.title: Status property
statusProperty.description: The item property that holds its status.

closedValues.title: Closed values
closedValues.description: The status values that count an item as closed.

dueProperty.title: Due date property
dueProperty.description: The item property that holds its due date.

health.description: How the body of work is doing: on track, at risk or off track.
health.title: Health

summary.description: A short written account of the state of the work.
summary.title: Summary

figures.description: The counts the product computed over the items.
figures.title: Figures

open.title: Open
open.description: The number of items not yet closed.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.description: The number of open items past their due date.

percentClosed.title: Percent closed
percentClosed.description: The share of items that are closed, as a percentage.

daysToDeadline.title: Days to deadline
daysToDeadline.description: The number of days until the deadline, if there is one.

provenance.title: Computed or written
provenance.description: Per value: computed by the product or written by a person.

date.title: Date source
date.description: Whether the date was computed or written.

health.title: Health source
health.description: Whether the health rating was computed or written.

summary.title: Summary source
summary.description: Whether the summary was computed or written.

figures.title: Figures source
figures.description: Per figure, whether it was computed or written.

author.description: The person who kept this report.
author.title: Kept by
